governance: Independently governed expected magnitudes for the RSI promotion-decision family (maistro-rsi). This file states the values the implementation must produce; it is NOT generated from or imported by production code, so a mutation of a production constant cannot silently rewrite its own expectation. Changing a value here is a policy change: it needs the same review as changing the production constant, plus the cited provenance (issue/ADR) updated in lockstep. 'exact' entries kill every magnitude mutation of the constant; 'range' entries are cost/record-shape knobs that are tunable within stated safe bounds (documented, not over-pinned).

regression_judge.REJECT_BELOW.provenance: #307 fail-closed regression judge; the judge's system prompt states the same 0.4 cutoff so model and gate cannot drift apart
regression_judge.REJECT_BELOW.protects: a parsed judge score below 0.4 is a flagged regression whose verdict is 'reject' and which vetoes promotion; >= 0.4 is 'pass'
regression_judge.REJECT_BELOW.kills: 0.4 -> 0.04 promotes flagged regressions (security hole); 0.4 -> 0.9 rejects nearly every clean candidate; 0.4 -> 0.45 shifts the verdict mapping off the documented cutoff

regression_judge._MAX_DIFF_CHARS.provenance: bounded prompt cost for the second-opinion judge; exact value pinned because the retention boundary (2x cap) is the correctness-bearing fail-closed point
regression_judge._MAX_DIFF_CHARS.protects: how much diff the judge may see per consultation; together with _MIN_RETAINED_FRACTION it decides when a diff is 'too large to judge whole'
regression_judge._MAX_DIFF_CHARS.kills: any change moves the 16000/16001-char fail-closed boundary, which the boundary test pins exactly

regression_judge._MIN_RETAINED_FRACTION.provenance: #307: the judge must never rule on a partial view that hides most of the change; at least half the diff must survive the cap
regression_judge._MIN_RETAINED_FRACTION.protects: a truncated diff retaining < 50% of its characters yields an 'unavailable' verdict that FAILS the promotion gate (fail closed) instead of a confident ruling on a hidden change
regression_judge._MIN_RETAINED_FRACTION.kills: 0.5 -> 0.1 lets the judge 'pass' a diff it saw 10% of; 0.5 -> 0.9 refuses nearly every large-but-judgeable diff

candidate_fitness._MUTATION_KILL_THRESHO.provenance: anti-reward-hacking veto: deliberately lenient at half so only changes whose tests miss the MAJORITY of introduced-behavior mutations are rejected
candidate_fitness._MUTATION_KILL_THRESHO.protects: the tests_pin_behavior gate: a candidate whose own tests kill fewer than half the diff-scoped mutants is under-verified and must not promote
candidate_fitness._MUTATION_KILL_THRESHO.kills: 0.5 -> 0.05 promotes overfit/reward-hacked candidates; 0.5 -> 0.9 rejects honest work over equivalent mutants; 0.5 -> 0.499 flips the 499/1000 boundary case

candidate_fitness._MUTATION_MAX_MUTANTS.provenance: cost cap only: each mutant reruns the changed tests once, so this bounds probe cost; the site list is truncated deterministically. Tunable within the stated bounds - a cap below 2 makes the probe statistically meaningless, above 20 it can dominate cycle wall-clock
candidate_fitness._MUTATION_MAX_MUTANTS.kills: out-of-range caps (e.g. 0 or 500) that make the probe meaningless or unaffordable

candidate_fitness._DELETED_TRACE_CAP.provenance: record-shape knob: how many deleted node IDs the protected-inventory gate's reason/detail/trace carry; the full count always rides along as deleted_count. Tunable within bounds - below 5 a realistic deletion list is truncated, above 100 a hostile mass-deletion bloats the promotion record
candidate_fitness._DELETED_TRACE_CAP.protects: legibility of the #306 shrink veto without unbounded record growth
candidate_fitness._DELETED_TRACE_CAP.kills: out-of-range caps that either hide deletions or enable record bloat

free_router.pick_attempt_multiplier.provenance: de-dup headroom for _pick_distinct: the free catalog is finite and the router/cache repeats picks, so up to 4x count attempts are made to find count DISTINCT free aliases before falling back to the default
free_router.pick_attempt_multiplier.protects: bounded OpenRouter resolution calls per roster sentinel (each attempt is a live HTTP call), while still giving the router enough tries to de-duplicate
free_router.pick_attempt_multiplier.kills: 4 -> 40 multiplies gateway/OpenRouter resolution traffic 10x per sentinel; 4 -> 1 collapses distinct-pick rosters to one alias
